title: Carrollian Worldsheets on Carrollian Targets, When does ILST describe a null string theory?
summary: Null string theory (NST) is a two-dimensional (2d) sigma-model on a Carrollian worldsheet with 2d diffeomorphisms, Weyl and Carroll-Weyl (CW) scalings as gauge symmetries whereas the Isberg-Lindström-Sundborg-Theodoridis (ILST) theory on a generic target space only realizes the first two and not the CW gauge symmetry. We show in this work that NST on the Carrollian target spaces (CTS) is well-defined if the background admits a homothetic kernel generator and that, it is described by the ILST theory on the same CTS.
